tax_withheld = pt['federal_tax'] + pt['state_tax']
expected = pre_tax_savings_rate(pt['gross_income'], tax_withheld, review['spending']['total'])
actual = pt['savings_rate_pct']

results.description: Yearly review total_income equals dal.cash_flow.get_yearly_cash_flow income for that year/owner
results.query_or_script:
wrap = get_yearly_wrapup(conn, 2025, owner_id='quintin')
ycf = get_yearly_cash_flow(conn, owner_id='quintin')
expected = {r['year']: r['income'] for r in ycf}[2025]
actual = wrap['total_income']
results.notes: year=2025, owner=quintin; NOTE: yearly_wrapup uses per-stream income (SUM signed_amount where category in INCOME_CATEGORIES) summed across streams; yearly_cash_flow uses canonical income clause (signed_amount > 0 AND category NOT IN INCOME_EXCL_FROM_INC). They can diverge for refunds in spending-cat that yearly_cf rejects vs. wrapup never sees because wrapup only iterates INCOME_CATEGORIES.

results.description: Yearly review total_spending equals dal.cash_flow.get_yearly_cash_flow spending

results.description: interest.net_cost equals interest_paid - interest_earned over year (signed)
